title: Encode and Decode TinyURL
description: Design a TinyURL encoder and decoder using a hash map to store long URLs.

steps.note: Encode 'google.com' by assigning it a new key.
Store the mapping in the hash map.
Encode 'leetcode.com' by assigning it the next available key.
Decode 'tinyurl.com/1' by looking it up in the map.
